title: IM60034: Principles And Applications Of Ergonomics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Cases and Empirical Studies on: Measuring Work by Physiological Methods,
Anthropometry in Work Place Design, Choice of Work Posture, Fatigue Measurement
and Evaluation, Physical Work and Heat Stress, Noise Exposure and Hearing Loss,
Effects of Noise on Human Performance, Industrial Product Design, Design for
Hand Tools and Manufacturing Assembly, Illumination at Work, Whole Body
Vibration, Design of VDT Work Station.Textbooks1.Human Factors in Engineering
and Design, Sanders, M. S. and McCormick, E. J., McGraw-Hill, Sixth
Edition.2.Introduction to Ergonomics, Bridger, R. S., McGraw-Hill, 1995.3.A
Guide to the Ergonomics of Manufacturing, Halender, M., East-West Press (Taylor
and Francis), 1996.
